notes.title: GourdsTown Recollection is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to GourdsTown once more.

Introducing Act10!

after finishing all the main act you can return to GourdsTown explore it and the world around it,
GourdsTown Recollection adds:
-two new areas to explore and interact.
-two new characters and interactions.
-more then four new tools for crafting and cooking new recipes.
-four new resources to collect new materials for cooking recipes.
-more then ten new recipes. (due to some issue other recipes planed are shelved right now)

Thank you All and Enjoy GourdsTown Recollection!

notes.title: GourdsTown : Light of the Town is Out Now
notes.notes:
GourdsTown : Light of the Town is Out! Finally!

This Update focuses around a new system called : Light of the Town
in this update throughout your journey in GourdsTown you will notice that the light inside the town sometimes decays...
if it reaches low levels gourds will start falling asleep, but do not worry! Mystic will help sustain emergency light while you go out and bring some thing to burn in the furnace (located in the Gate House's Hidden Room).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215577/77a9507df5e8b79da2f5a23aa43070f983d3e0d6.png[/img]
in addition I have added a Chest! want to hold more than 5 materials at a time, there's a tool just for you (in the abandoned House) the Chest adds 3 more Slots, make sure to make good use of these Extra material slots and the chest special ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43215577/ed29bab563555716ba98c6588c4386aed878ef92.png[/img]
to celebrate the release of GourdsTown : Light of the Town there is a 40% Sale from 1st of September until the 15th.

notes.title: Light of the Town Release Notes
notes.notes:
Light of the Town :

- all new animations for all characters including player.
- chest added bring the ability to save materials between acts.
- Light of the Town System added bringing new challenge to half of the acts by requiring player to take care of the Towns own light levels, and reignite the furnace (located in the Gate House) if light reach low levels.
- revised resolution system.
- bugs fixed.
